name: BSP_PowerUp_AppliesToUnit
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet hud_central_updates, docs/HUD_CENTRAL_UPDATES.md. __thiscall(entry, unit) returning a byte, body 008E62A0..008E6367. Returns 0 unless 008E3680 passes. Dispatches on the descriptor type at [[entry+4]+8]: type 3 with a non-null [entry+8] compares the scope byte at [[entry+4]+84h], where 4 means the unit shares [unit+180h] with [[entry+8]+4] and 5 means it shares [unit+54h]; type 2 scans sixteen 0Ch-byte list heads at [00F88C30+84h+i*0Ch] for a node whose +8h is this entry and that passes 008E4680(node+8, unit). The HUD root update 00649860 calls it once per power-up entry with the controlled unit 00E188D8 to decide whether the entry gets an icon.

name: BSP_PowerUpManager_CollectActive
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet hud_central_updates, docs/HUD_CENTRAL_UPDATES.md. Body 008E9AF0..008E9FC4. Called once from the HUD root update 00649860 at 00649A36 with ECX = [00F88C30], the power-up manager, and seven arguments: five of the screen's std::vector objects at this+164h, +124h, +134h, +144h and +154h, then literal 0 and 1. The HUD root reads +164h as the untimed entries, +124h as the timed entries and +154h as their float deadlines; +134h and +144h are filled but not read there, so their roles are unknown. Identified by its call site and its output use only; the body was not read.

name: BSP_PowerUpManager_Update
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_world_entities, read-only analysis. __thiscall(this), RET (008eb341), no argument, ECX DAT_00f88c30 from BSP_Game_OnMove at 004e535a. Runs 008eac80, then sixteen channel lists at this+84h with stride 0Ch (008eb14e counts 16, piVar8 advances three dwords): any node whose value+18h float is below the clock 00f876a4 gets 008e8c30(value), with no erase. Then the per-player list at this+14Ch + slot*0Ch, slot taken from game+18ECh, the active local-player slot. The deadline is value+18h, or *(value+10h)+80h plus the clock when value+1Ch is set, which re-derives it every frame and fires only once that source float is negative. Crossing it latches value+8h and, when the ready list size at this+28h + slot*0Ch is non-zero, builds the literal pup_ready and calls 009789a0(slot, readyHead->_Prev + 8, &string). 00613760 runs at the end of every iteration. Segment 58 keywords pup_gain, pum1stget, uspumicon. docs/GAME_WORLD_ENTITIES.md.
